summary: The replies a scripted adviser returns for each gated packet. Nothing here is a model output; each reply is written by hand and is inert text the product records and never acts on.
assumptions: the localisation is an interval and not a confirmed point
the reply reads the packet only and never the published rows

key.cause: the publication step joined the channel reference at a grain that repeats a case reference
key.proposed_fix: restore the declared one row per case reference before the report is published
key.discriminating_test: count the published rows against the distinct case references for the business date

population.cause: the publication step dropped settled cases the declared population keeps
population.proposed_fix: restore the declared population filter for the business date
population.discriminating_test: count the published population against the reconciled case population

effective-date.cause: the publication step carried the previous effective date onto the published rows
effective-date.proposed_fix: publish each case against the effective date the reconciliation declares
effective-date.discriminating_test: compare the published effective date with the reconciled effective date per case

calculation.cause: the publication step rounded the resolution rate at a place the declared scale does not carry
calculation.proposed_fix: carry the declared decimal scale through the resolution rate calculation
calculation.discriminating_test: recompute the resolution rate at the declared scale and compare the last declared place
